title: BALUMUKA – Prague Kizomba Festival
description:
Balumuka is Back!
Prague Kizomba Festival
After a long break, Balumuka is finally back — and we couldn’t be more excited to welcome you!
While the festival took a pause, we never stopped moving. We’ve been busy co-producing unforgettable live shows with world-class artists like Rema, Omah Lay, and Victony. We’ve also launched the Afro RAVE parties, uniting the Afro Diaspora and street dance lovers in a celebration of rhythm, culture, and pure vibes.
Now, it’s time to come home.
This special Balumuka edition is a family reunion — a chance to reconnect with old friends, share stories, and grow from our new experiences together.
🫂 Limited number of guests for a more intimate experience.
🛏️ IBIS Old Town– but don’t worry, the hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the party location.
🪩 KLUBOVNA 2 PATRO – Is the chosen venue for our parties, 5min from the main hotel
Let’s make new memories. Let’s dance like never before.
Let’s bring the love back.

🔥 Balumuka Prague Kizomba Festival 2026 – The Heartbeat of Dance Culture
Welcome to the most original Kizomba festival on the planet—Balumuka, where tradition meets innovation right in the vibrant center of Prague. This isn’t just a dance event—it’s a full-body, full-soul experience designed to elevate your artistry and immerse you in a cultural celebration like no other.
💃 What Makes Balumuka So Unique?
– 🎧 DJ & Musicality Workshops
Learn how to feel the music, not just follow it. These sessions help you connect rhythm with movement in a way that transforms your dancing.
– 🧭 Kizomba Ethics
Dive into the roots and respectful practices of the dance. Understand the cultural context and values that make Kizomba more than just steps.
– 🎨 Afro Tribal Dance Art Installation
A visual and kinetic tribute to African heritage—where dance meets art in a powerful fusion.
– 🎉 Socials & After-Parties at the Main Hotel
Keep the energy flowing with cozy, late-night socials just steps from your room.
– 🌃 Night Parties – Just 4 Minutes Away
No long commutes—just a short walk to the dance floor, where the magic happens.
– 🛍️ Shopping & Sightseeing
A massive shopping mall next door and Prague’s iconic attractions are within walking distance. Dance by night, explore by day.
🛒 REGISTRATION OPEN!
Prague Kizomba Festival – Nov. 6 – 9th 2026
Get ready for an electrifying celebration of rhythm, connection, and culture in the heart of Prague! 💃🕺
